study type: randomised, double blind, single centre study
cohort: 140 pregnant women at term undergoing labor induction
finding: The efficacy and safety of 25 microg intravaginal misoprostol were comparable with 50 microg of intravaginal misoprostol for labour induction.
mod_finding: 50 microg misoprostol was associated with a higher rate of vaginal deliveries and shorter induction time but also with higher frequencies of maternal and neonatal complications.
